title: Deactivating a term another user just made the default is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2 Second Admin.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-30 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page is open on the Active tab in both browsers.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In {User-B}'s browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Make Default for New Customers".
  3. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Make Default".
  4. In your browser, without reloading, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  5. Click "Deactivate".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {User-B}'s menu opens.
  • Step 2: {User-B}'s confirmation opens.
  • Step 3: {User-B} sees the toast "{Term-A} is now the default".
  • Step 4: your menu still shows "Deactivate" available (your page has not reloaded).
  • Step 5: the app's error alert shows "This is your default for new customers. Pick another default first." and {Term-A} stays on the Active tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-E2: “If a term becomes in use, becomes the default, or is changed by another user after the page loaded, the save is refused with the reason in S2 Error Handling, and the page keeps its state.”
  • Story 2, Error Handling: “If a save is refused, the app's standard error alert shows the reason, using these exact texts: "This is your default for new customers. Pick another default first." (deactivating or deleting the default); "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." (editing or deleting a term in use); "Always available. COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated."; "Pick an active term other than Credit Hold." (making an inactive term or Credit Hold the default); "Credit term not found." (the term was deleted meanwhile). The delete confirmation stays open when the delete is refused.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Deactivate or delete of the default refused (server) | "This is your default for new customers. Pick another default first." | Standard error alert”
